title: Eric Davis says President George H.W. Bush told him about multiple UAP crash retrievals since 1940s
description:
Eric Davis: “In 2003, I had a few private conversations with George Herbert Walker Bush (41st President of the United States) During these discussions, he told me that multiple crash retrievals had occurred since the mid‑1940s. He also recounted that in 1964, at Holloman Air Force Base, three UAPs approached the base. One of them landed on the tarmac, and a non‑human intelligence entity disembarked from the craft, engaging directly with Air Force and CIA personnel.”

Clip taken from The Age Of Disclosure documentray (watch it now on Amazon Prime)
